name: 43968 · Wellsville, OH
findings: ZIP 43968 (Wellsville) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43968 (Wellsville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43968 (Wellsville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
